Who I Am

About Me

Hey! I'm Vivek Kumar, a passionate Full Stack Web Developer currently pursuing B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at Lucknow Institute of Technology.

I love building complete web applications — from pixel-perfect frontends to robust backends. My core stack is React, Node.js, Express & MongoDB, and I'm always exploring new technologies to level up my craft.

I believe in writing clean, maintainable code and creating user experiences that are both functional and beautiful. Every day is a chance to learn something new and build something better.
